skills.name: Subtract same-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts once they have a common denominator, including keeping the denominator, handling zero results, and reducing the fractional answer to lowest terms.

skills.name: Convert to common denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator for unlike fractional parts and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Manage mixed/whole parts without regrouping
skills.definition: Separate, subtract, carry, and recombine whole-number and fractional parts in mixed-number or whole-number subtraction when no borrowing from the whole part is needed.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units as fractional units to make the minuend’s fractional part large enough before subtracting and recombining.
